messages:
Ava (Sales): @Elena thanks for the quick call earlier — customer wants a compact artifact for their vendor risk team: subprocessor picklist, a simple data flow boundary for EU-only hosting, and screenshots/evidence of KMS + logging.
Elena (Acme): Yep — they want something short (1 page diagram + one page table). Also asked whether we perform any pseudonymization before storage.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Short answer: we do optional field-level pseudonymization in Dedicated/Private via transform hooks. Hosted API: we recommend tokenization/pseudonymization client-side or via our prefix-caching layer; we do not modify customer input by default.
Priya (Security): For the write-up, I'll include the subprocessor list (compute, monitoring, storage, logging, KMS). Also will note that Hosted uses cloud-provider-managed encryption, and Dedicated/Private can use customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key).
Marco (Legal): Can you add explicit language confirming no cross-border replication for EU region deployments? We need wording for the contract addendum.
Ava (Sales): @Marco noted. @Sam @Priya can we produce: 1) one-page PNG data boundary (EU only) 2) table: subprocessor, purpose, country, data types 3) short evidence snippets (KMS config screenshots, audit-log sample). Customer wants by EOD Thurs.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I can grab screenshots from a test EU tenant and redact tenant IDs. Will include a small ASCII dataflow for quick review:
```
[Client EU] --> HTTPS --> [Redwood Inference EU Cluster (no replication)]
   auth: SSO/SAML or API key
   kms: CMEK (customer opt) or platform-managed
   logs: read-only audit logs -> SIEM (configurable)
```
Priya (Security): For the subprocessor table I'll export the canonical list and add countries. Quick list: GCP europe-west (compute/storage), Stripe (billing, Ireland), Datadog (monitoring, EU data processor), HashiCorp HSM partner (key escrow if enabled), Sentry (error telemetry, EU config). I'll flag any that store metadata outside EU.
Elena (Acme): Important: their security team requires that no message content is stored outside EU for the POC. Can we confirm that for Hosted?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Hosted default is multi-region for HA; however we can pin a tenant to eu-* regions in our Hosted offering for POCs (regional tenancy, no cross-region replication) — will confirm and document runbook steps.
Priya (Security): I'll add a short section: "POC regional tenancy — how we pin and prevent replication" plus the audit evidence we will attach (index names, example KMS key alias, and a redacted sample audit log entry).
Marco (Legal): Also add the clause text we can propose: "Provider will not replicate customer content outside the EU for the duration of the POC unless Customer explicitly authorizes in writing."
Ava (Sales): Perfect. Assigning owners: Sam -> diagrams + screenshots; Priya -> subprocessor table + security note + sample log; Marco -> contract clause text. I'll bundle into a single PDF and share with Elena for submission to their vendor team.
deploy-bot: deployment:staging deployed to eu cluster at 2024-11-07T12:04:02Z :white_check_mark: (irrelevant but shows screenshot source).
Elena (Acme): Thanks — that's great. One last ask: can you include a mapping to SIG/CAIQ questions for the key controls we mention (encryption, logging, subprocessors)? Their team asks for mapped evidence.
Priya (Security): Yes — I'll add a 1/2 page mapping: control -> evidence artifact (e.g., "Encryption in transit" -> TLS config screenshot; "KMS" -> key alias screenshot; "Subprocessors" -> CSV export).
Ava (Sales): ETA: I'll send the draft bundle by Thu 18:00 UTC. If any blocker, ping here. :thumbsup:
